say:4:1035408003:1.source_cn: 害，不是就行。你往旁边站站？有点挡我阳光了。

say:6:1035408004:1.text: No, I'm picking fruits. I just happen to enjoy working under the sunshine.
say:6:1035408004:1.source_cn: 不不不，我在认真的摘果子。然后摘果子的过程中顺便晒个太...

say:7:1035408005:1.text: If you ask me, my boss is heartless. Why else would he ask me to pick so much fruit on my own?
say:7:1035408005:1.source_cn: 依我看，这老板的心肯定是黑的，不然怎么让我一个人采摘那...

say:8:1035408006:1.text: Let someone else do this job for once! Anyway, I'm not gonna even waste a minute here. I'll go back after sundown.
say:8:1035408006:1.source_cn: 这工作谁爱干谁干吧，反正我今天打算等太阳下山了再回去！

say:9:1035408007:1.text: I'll just tell my boss that most of the fruit wasn't ripe enough to eat.
say:9:1035408007:1.source_cn: 到时候我就跟老板说，树上很多果子都没熟，没法儿摘。

say:11:1035408008:1.text: Ah?! Y-You... I'll get right back to work! I swear I wasn't slacking off! I was just getting some rest after I took a nasty fall!
say:11:1035408008:1.source_cn: 啊？你你……我……我在干活呢！我没有偷懒，我就是刚刚不...

say:12:1035408009:1.text: B-But I'm good now. I'll get right back to work!
say:12:1035408009:1.source_cn: 我……我现在好了，这就去继续干活！
